invariants.rationale: A return value of type HoodieWriteMetadata<List<WriteStatus>> is produced, implying non-null under normal operation.
The method constructs result via a call to clone with a non-null List.
The clone method is called with a List, so getWriteStatuses() should return a List.
A List's size is always non-negative.
The WriteStatus list is taken directly from collectAsList(), which should not produce null elements.
